notes.purpose: jaxfne/analysis is jaxfne's population-level and spectral analysis toolkit: dimensionless numpy metrics on spike trains (metrics.py) plus JIT-compilable JAX spectral/spectrolaminar kernels (spectral.py). It is a flat 2-file-plus-init subpackage (no core+backends split, no subdirectories) — one file per concern: metrics.py = numpy spike-train statistics, spectral.py = jax.jit/vmap DFT-based PSD/bandpower/similarity kernels used by the spectrolaminar objective/tuning path.
key_findings: File count: 4 entries in jaxfne/analysis/ (__init__.py 48 lines, metrics.py 399 lines, spectral.py 168 lines, plus a stray .DS_Store 6148 bytes and __pycache__/) — 615 total lines of source across the 3 .py files.

__init__.py (lines 22-48) re-exports exactly 10 names as __all__: 4 from metrics.py (mean_pairwise_spike_correlation, burst_index, fano_factor, fleiss_kappa_binary) and 6 from spectral.py (spectrolaminar_psd_jax, bandpower_jax, spectrolaminar_readout_kernel_jax, spectrolaminar_similarity_kernel_jax, spectrolaminar_similarity_candidates_jax, spectrolaminar_similarity_candidates_seeds_jax) — this is the full public surface; nothing else in the two files is exported at the subpackage level.

metrics.py functions take numpy/jax arrays and return plain Python floats (docstring line 4-5, verified in each function's final `return float(...)`), all numpy-based (no jax.jit) — contrasts with spectral.py which is jax.jit/vmap throughout (spectral.py:16,57,89,127) and stays in jax.Array space.

spectral.py's two vmap'd batch entry points (lines 160-168) are built by wrapping spectrolaminar_similarity_kernel_jax with jax.vmap (single-batch) and a nested double jax.vmap (seeds x candidates) — no separate implementation, pure composition.

jaxfne/__init__.py imports this subpackage twice: `from . import analysis` (line 127, gives jaxfne.analysis.*) and separately re-exports the 6 spectral kernel names directly onto the jaxfne root namespace via `from .analysis.spectral import (...)` (jaxfne/__init__.py:301-308) -- so spectrolaminar_psd_jax etc. are reachable as both jaxfne.analysis.X and jaxfne.X.

Every metrics.py docstring carries an explicit truth-gate line: 'Claim level: computational_scaffold (no biological interpretation)' (e.g. metrics.py:60,155,234,331) and the module docstring states 'Metrics are dimensionless descriptors, not biological validation. No biological truth claims are supported.' (metrics.py:7-9).
